prompt:
Create a native4K landscape16:9 spatial reference sheet of ONE ancient Chinese mountain footpath, three consistent views, no writing or arrows. Clean restrained2D animation background, simple warm gray rocks, muted olive grass, dry tan soil, fine calm outlines, broad two-level shading, no grain or photoreal detail.
Exact ground plan: a single path climbs from the SOUTH foreground toward the NORTH. It begins wide enough for TWO adults side by side, then narrows gently. At the middle bend it turns EAST (RIGHT when looking north) and disappears IMMEDIATELY BEHIND a solid rocky shoulder. The continuation is hidden by that north-side rock, so do not show a distant path running off to the west or over an exposed cliff. This is a modest sheltered slope, NO sheer drop, precipice, bridge, ravine, second fork or shortcut. The mountain temple lies farther up out of sight: show NO temple gate, building, roof or shrine.
On the WEST side of the bend, exactly TWO broad flat-topped knee-high sitting stones are beside each other, with a small clear ground patch beside them reserved for a future water jar and bowl, but leave that patch empty. To the EAST is a low grassy slope that joins the rock naturally and is not a second trail. The same two sitting stones remain on the west side in every view. Dry road, no puddles or wet soil, no people, animals, containers or plot props.
Layout: large left view looks uphill from the SOUTH so the two sitting stones are to the LEFT and the trail curves RIGHT into a short concealed gap behind the rock. Upper-right is a simple roofless overhead terrain plan with NORTH at the top, showing only the visible south path and its short rightward bend before it disappears under the rocky shoulder. Lower-right looks back SOUTH from the bend, with the same two west sitting stones on the viewer's RIGHT and the clear downhill path centered. Three views share one geometry; don't invent another bend for a panel. Keep the whole resting area and dry lower approach visible. Ordinary diffuse daytime light, no dramatic mist, sunset or night lighting. No labels, numbers, captions, letters, dimension lines or arrows.
